info.name: RetailTrack API
info.description:
Complete request set for the RetailTrack backend.

1. Import this collection and the "RetailTrack Local" environment.
2. Fill in the passwords in the environment (the admin comes from ADMIN_* in backend/.env).
3. Run "Auth -> Login as Admin", then use any folder. IDs created by earlier requests (categoryId, productId, saleId...) are stored automatically as collection variables.

Staff and cashier accounts: create them with "Users -> Create user" and set their emails/passwords in the environment, then use "Login as Staff / Cashier" to test role restrictions.
